items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: No direct interaction between the interviewee and Estaño is described; the interviewer mentions giving a picture to Estaño.

ctx.x: I see. New City is not far from here?
No, no. His wife is a great photographer. She took that picture and I gave it to Estaño and he copied it for the album. Volume No. 2 has my picture, my portrait on the album.
